title: AgentBouncer: Defending Software Engineering Agents via Dynamic System-Call Mediation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30621v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software engineering (SE) agents can complete diverse engineering tasks by interacting with the development environment via tools that access files, run commands, and download resources. Unfortunately, the same ability that makes SE agents useful also makes them prone to performing unintended malicious actions through prompt injections, malicious tools, or supply-chain attacks. Existing defenses that analyze the agent trajectory may fail to detect such attacks, as they inspect only the initial prompt and the sequence of tool calls, but not the actual actions that are executed in the environment. This paper presents AgentBouncer, a novel runtime enforcement system that prevents SE agents from performing malicious actions by mediating, and if necessary denying, system calls that agents trigger via tool calls. The core of AgentBouncer is an LLM arbiter that judges system calls along two axes, necessity and safety for the current task. It

translated_title: AgentBouncer：通过动态系统调用中介防御软件工程智能体
translated_abstract: 软件工程（SE）智能体可以通过与开发环境交互来完成多样化的工程任务，这些交互借助访问文件、运行命令和下载资源的工具来实现。然而，正是这种使SE智能体有用的能力，也使它们容易通过提示注入、恶意工具或供应链攻击而执行非预期的恶意操作。现有的分析智能体轨迹的防御方法可能无法检测到此类攻击，因为它们仅检查初始提示和工具调用序列，而不检查在环境中实际执行的操作。本文提出了AgentBouncer，这是一种新颖的运行时强制执行系统，通过中介（并在必要时拒绝）智能体通过工具调用触发的系统调用，来防止SE智能体执行恶意操作。AgentBouncer的核心是一个LLM仲裁器，它从两个维度判断系统调用：必要性和对当前任务的安全性。
tldr: AgentBouncer是一种运行时强制执行系统，利用LLM仲裁器从必要性和安全性两个维度中介（必要时拒绝）软件工程智能体触发的系统调用，从而有效防御提示注入、恶意工具和供应链攻击。
en_tdlr: AgentBouncer is a novel runtime enforcement system that defends software engineering agents against prompt injections, malicious tools, and supply-chain attacks by mediating agent-triggered system calls through an LLM arbiter that judges their necessity and safety for the current task.
